key_highlights: ASX suffers sharp correction with $169B erased across the week amid recession fears
Unemployment spikes to 5-year high, triggering expectations that RBA rate hike cycle has ended
Severe consumer stress evident as David Jones sheds 1,700 staff and enters creditor talks
Accelerating residential property downturn in Sydney and Melbourne undermines bank lending margins
AUD weakness and capital market volatility contrast with targeted resilience in gold and critical minerals

sectors.trend: Gold exploration and project restarts gain traction alongside rare earth metallurgical breakthroughs, offsetting broader market liquidity constraints.
sectors.implications: Strong defensive and currency-tailwinds for gold producers; selective capital availability for critical minerals juniors.

sectors.trend: Asset quality risks increase as five rate hikes compress borrowing power, while regulatory and underpayment scrutiny hits major lenders.
sectors.implications: Downside risks to credit growth, margin compression on mortgage books, and elevated loan impairment provisions.

sectors.trend: Department store contraction deepens with David Jones job cuts and restructuring, allowing rivals to poach market share.
sectors.implications: Intensified margin compression across cyclical retail; selective consolidation benefits for resilient competitors.

sectors.trend: Rapid housing market downturn in Sydney and Victoria, with falling asset values and tight borrowing capacity.
sectors.implications: Devaluation pressure on residential developers and diversified REIT property valuations.

sectors.trend: Real household incomes decline as inflation outstrips wage gains; dietary shifts linked to GLP-1 weight-loss drugs begin impacting food volumes.
sectors.implications: Subdued supermarket volume growth; relative resilience in global healthcare and pharma names.

sectors.trend: AI-driven restructuring hits professional hiring and corporate headcounts, while equity value creation concentrates in private AI leaders.
sectors.implications: Disruption across traditional enterprise service providers; capital rotation toward proven software productivity plays.

sectors.trend: Domestic wholesale gas market pressures persist amidst policy tensions regarding fossil fuel alignments.
sectors.implications: Sustained input cost risks for domestic industrial users; regulatory scrutiny on wholesale gas margins.

key_themes: Macroeconomic hard-landing concerns as labor market conditions soften abruptly
Terminal rate reached for the RBA as rate hikes choke consumer borrowing capacity
Broad-based equity sell-off impacting large-cap indices
Flight to safe-haven commodities and offshore-earning assets amid AUD depreciation

risk_assessment.mitigation: Rotate out of cyclical and consumer discretionary equities into defensive large-caps and cash equivalents.
Underweight domestic residential developers and banks with concentrated domestic mortgage loan books.
Maintain exposure to USD-denominated commodity producers and global healthcare exporters.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Retail and Commercial Discretionary Default Waves
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid leveraged retail chains and sub-regional retail mall REITs exposed to department store tenancies.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight unhedged gold miners and explorers amid monetary easing prospects and weak AUD.
opportunities.rationale: Gold producers provide an effective hedge against domestic equity drawdown, currency weakness, and macro stress.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on department store consolidation by taking tactical positions in surviving department store operators.
opportunities.rationale: Myer stands to absorb displaced high-margin concessions, supplier contracts, and customer traffic from David Jones.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate defensive global healthcare leaders with predominantly offshore USD earnings.
opportunities.rationale: CSL offers revenue diversification insulated from Australian domestic retail stress and benefits from a lower AUD.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to Australian major banks vulnerable to mortgage arrears and falling collateral values.
defensive_moves.rationale: Five cumulative cash rate hikes and sharp Sydney housing price falls heighten bad debt and margin compression risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Implement downside index hedges or hold elevated cash balances against broader Australian equity benchmark exposure.
defensive_moves.rationale: A $169B weekly wipeout coupled with surging unemployment points to persistent volatility and further multiple compression.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish over 1–3 months for the ASX 200 (^AXJO) as earnings downgrade cycles accelerate and household spending contracts.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive over 6–12 months as the RBA confirms a pause/pivot to rate cuts, stabilising housing and valuations.
key_catalysts: RBA Board interest rate statement and formal monetary policy shift
